findings.title: Watch unresolved external dependency paths
findings.body: The existence guard prevents every currently missing `unresolvedDependency` from being registered. For a relative type import outside `configRoot` that is already missing when the server starts (for example, it was deleted while the persistent cache was offline), Vite's root watcher does not observe its parent and no prior `unlink` event runs `dependencyUnlinkHandler` to re-arm the path. Recreating that declaration therefore produces no `add` event, so the reverse index is never consulted and the affected component keeps stale metadata. Register missing unresolved external paths (or their parent directory) as well; the same issue occurs when a deleted import is recreated under another candidate extension.

overall_explanation: Persistent validation and edits to already watched external files are covered, but unresolved external dependencies that are absent at watcher-registration time cannot subsequently trigger HMR when created. This leaves a concrete freshness gap in the external type-watch behavior.
